_meta.title: UNET
_meta.note: krea2-Turbo GGUF primary model. The panel is generated as an IMG2IMG redraw of the scene's location master plate (reference-first design): the plate is encoded to a 16-channel latent and the KSampler re-draws it with a denoise < 1.0, so the background stays anchored to the plate while the character sd_prompt is composited in. NOW USES KREA2 NATIVE VAE (qwen_image_vae) for 768x448 resolution.

_meta.title: CLIP
_meta.note: Qwen3-VL-4B fp8_scaled text encoder for krea2.

_meta.title: VAE
_meta.note: Qwen-Image VAE (16-channel latent) for encode/decode. Krea2 native VAE.

_meta.title: PLATE_IMG
_meta.note: Scene location master plate (no people) at 768x448. Uploaded by stage3b via comfy.upload_image(); the registered filename is patched here as PATCH_PLATE. Every shot in the scene starts from this same plate.

_meta.title: PLATE_ENCODE
_meta.note: Encodes the plate to krea2 latent space via qwen_image_vae; becomes the KSampler's starting latent. Resolution is inherited from the plate (768x448), so no EmptySD3LatentImage is needed.

_meta.title: PROMPT_POS
_meta.note: The assembled sd_prompt (character description + composition/environment tokens) lands here; composited onto the plate's backdrop. Same anchors as stage1r's character reference sheets so identities stay consistent.

_meta.title: NEG_ZEROOUT
_meta.note: krea2-Turbo is CFG-distilled (cfg=1.0); negative is a zero-out of the positive.

_meta.title: SAMPLER
_meta.note: krea2 IMG2IMG recipe at 768x448: euler/simple, 12 steps, cfg 1.5. DENOISE 0.2 (tight plate lock for background consistency). SEED patched per shot.

_meta.title: DECODE
_meta.note: Decodes the redrawn latent back to RGB via qwen_image_vae.

_meta.title: REFINE_SHARPEN
_meta.note: Stock ComfyUI post-decode detail refinement. Light, GPU-cheap (no second KSampler pass, so no 8GB OOM risk). Knobs SHARPEN_RADIUS / SHARPEN_SIGMA / SHARPEN_ALPHA are patchable from stack.toml [animation]; set alpha 0.0 to bypass.

_meta.title: SAVE
_meta.note: Writes the panel PNG under ComfyUI/output/<SAVE_PREFIX>; ComfyClient copies it into the project panels dir.
